title: SiuuuHomes
description: Paper homes plugin with a bed GUI.
body:
# SiuuuHomes

A lightweight and easy-to-use homes plugin for Paper 1.21.x servers.

SiuuuHomes allows players to create custom homes, teleport to them instantly, and manage them through a simple bed-based GUI. Every home is displayed as a bed item, making navigation intuitive and beginner-friendly.

## Features

✅ Create unlimited custom-named homes

✅ Bed-based GUI for home management

✅ Instant teleportation

✅ Delete homes directly from the GUI

✅ Lightweight and fast

✅ YAML storage

✅ Simple setup

✅ Paper 1.21.x support

## Commands

### Create a Home

```text
/sethome <name>
```

Examples:

```text
/sethome base
/sethome mine
/sethome village
/sethome 1
/sethome 2
```

Creates a home at your current location using the specified name.

---

### Open the Homes GUI

```text
/home
```

Opens a GUI displaying all of your saved homes as bed icons.

---

### Delete a Home

```text
/delhome <name>
```

Examples:

```text
/delhome base
/delhome mine
```

Removes the selected home permanently.

## GUI Controls

### Left Click

Teleport to the selected home.

### Right Click

Delete the selected home.

## Example Usage

Create a base home:

```text
/sethome base
```

Create a mining home:

```text
/sethome mine
```

Open the GUI:

```text
/home
```

Click the bed named **base** to teleport to your base.

Right-click the bed named **mine** to delete the mining home.

## Storage

Homes are stored in:

```text
plugins/SiuuuHomes/homes.yml
```

Example:

```yaml
players:
  uuid:
    homes:
      base:
        world: world
        x: 100
        y: 64
        z: 100

      mine:
        world: world
        x: -200
        y: 12
        z: 350
```

## Compatibility

* Paper 1.21.x
* Java 21

## Installation

1. Download the latest release.
2. Place the JAR into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Start or restart the server.
4. Enjoy using SiuuuHomes.

## Why SiuuuHomes?

Many homes plugins are packed with unnecessary features and complicated configuration. SiuuuHomes focuses on what players actually need:

* Fast home creation
* Easy GUI navigation
* Simple commands
* Lightweight performance

No complicated setup. No confusing menus. Just homes.

## Support

If you find a bug or have a suggestion, please open an issue on GitHub.

Have fun using SiuuuHomes on your server!
